title: Avengers #252 Marvel 1985 Blood Brothers vs Hercules Roger Stern Bob Hall
conditionDescription: Bright, glossy cover with light handling wear at the edges. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Avengers #252 (February 1985), Marvel Comics - "Deciding Factor!" The Blood Brothers smash Hercules. Written by Roger Stern; cover by Bob Hall and Joe Sinnott. With Captain America, Scarlet Witch and Starfox. Direct edition, 60 cent cover price.

Back cover: Parker Brothers Risk board game ad.

Condition: bright, glossy cover with light handling wear at the edges (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
